_comment: Fiscal-year-2026 grounded actuals — Alibaba's fiscal year ENDS 31 MARCH, so FY2026 = year ended 31-Mar-2026 (reported 12-May-2026; the latest reported FY). Reports in RMB (CNY), HK/NYSE-listed. Source: Alibaba FY2026 results (alibabagroup.com / Businesswire / SEC 6-K). Total revenue RMB 1,023,670mn (US$148.4bn), +2.7% YoY (vs RMB 996,347mn FY2025). Net income RMB 102,127mn (-19% YoY); net income attributable to ordinary shareholders RMB 105,904mn. Non-GAAP net income RMB 60,658mn (-62% YoY) — the profit decline reflects heavy AI/cloud capex and strategic reinvestment, NOT demand weakness. EPS omitted (ADS-vs-ordinary share basis); operating margin / FCF not cleanly captured here.
